headline: Approved Superintendent's SY26-27 goals and a $10,000.00 donation from Watts Water Technologies.
summary: The meeting began with an executive session on a grievance with the Medford Teachers Association and on potential litigation. Members approved the consent agenda and the Superintendent's goals, each by a 7-0 vote. Members also expressed condolences to two families.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including bills and payrolls, a $10,000.00 donation from Watts Water Technologies, and the August 24, 2026 meeting minutes, by a 7-0 vote.
Approved the Superintendent's goals for SY26-27, by a 7-0 vote.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to approve the consent agenda, as amended to include the full text in the minutes of August 24, 2026, of 2026-22 by Member Reinfeld second by Member Ruseau- 7/0
Motion to approve the goals of the Superintendent by Member Ruseau second by Member Reinfeld-7/0
